note: Status di stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); requirement punya status. Demo remark: 'Using ad-hoc sms/email'. Opsi Send Email/SMS ada di form keputusan, officer memilih channel dan penerima, lalu setelah approval tersimpan email/SMS dikirim lewat SMTP dan APIM SMS dan dicatat. Satu langkah Sebagian: isi template (apakah mengajak membayar) disimpan di template store di database, bukan di repo, jadi cannot verify from repo; OCMS-DF-2026-136 (Closed, Prod deployed) mencatat dropdown template pernah kosong. Hal yang perlu diwaspadai: pesan hanya terkirim bila officer menekan 'Add to send list' (compose_list tidak kosong); mencentang Send Email/SMS saja tanpa itu hanya menyimpan approval (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:215-233). Kegagalan kirim tidak membatalkan approval. Pengiriman asli ke SMTP URA dan APIM SMS cannot verify from repo; di repo email.enableSmtp=true (application.properties:133) dan sms.enable=true (application-prod.properties:36), nilai di server sebenarnya cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Klaim: opsi kirim email/SMS setelah approval, pilihan channel dan penerima, serta pencatatan terbukti. Konfirmasi ke URA bahwa isi template memang mengajak membayar (ada di database, tidak di repo)

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The officer assesses the details and approves the particulars as Hirer or Driver
steps.detail: Box 'OIC Review' punya Decision Status dan, bila Approve, pilihan 'Approve As' Driver/Hirer (DecisionForm.tsx:436-470). Submit memanggil approveFurnish ke manual-review/approve-hirer atau approve-driver (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:193-200; useFurnishAPI.ts:205-225; ManualReviewController.java:171-255). Logika approval dan efek ke notice (HST, stage) di luar lingkup story ini.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The decision form offers a Send Email/SMS option
steps.detail: Checkbox 'Send Email/SMS' (sendEmailSms) ada di box OIC Review (DecisionForm.tsx:471-481); bila dicentang tab 'Reply' muncul (Form.tsx:88-90, 240-247). Opsi ini hanya tampil selama submission belum Approved/Rejected (DecisionForm.tsx:435).

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The officer chooses email and/or SMS and the recipient, the furnished hirer/driver
steps.detail: Message Mode Email atau SMS dipilih per entri dan 'Add to send list' menambah entri ke compose_list, sehingga satu approval bisa membawa email dan SMS sekaligus (ReplyComposeForm.tsx:57-80, 91-112). Dropdown Recipients (Owner/Driver/Hirer) mengisi emailTo atau mobile dari furnishEmailAddr/furnishTelNo bila indikator cocok, atau dari data owner bila Owner (ComposeEditor.tsx:211-266). Penerima tidak dipaksa hanya furnished person; officer bisa memilih Owner.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The officer picks a ready-made message that advises the hirer/driver to settle the notice
steps.detail: SelectTemplate memuat template FURNISH_* dari POST templatestorelist dan menyaringnya menurut keputusan dan penerima, misalnya Approve + Hirer = FURNISH_EMAIL_HIRER / FURNISH_SMS_HIRER, Driver = FURNISH_EMAIL_DRIVER / FURNISH_SMS_DRIVER (SelectTemplate.tsx:28-61, 71-117), lalu merender via templatestore/render. Isi template disimpan di database, bukan di repo, jadi apakah kalimatnya memberi tahu offence dan meminta membayar cannot verify from repo. Officer juga bisa menyunting isi (ComposeEditor). OCMS-DF-2026-136 (Closed, Prod deployed) mencatat dropdown template pernah kosong; saya tidak memverifikasi perbaikannya.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The system saves the approval, then sends the emails/SMS in the send list
steps.detail: Urutan submit: approveFurnish (atau rejectFurnish) dulu; bila sukses dan sendEmailSms dicentang serta compose_list tidak kosong, composeFurnish mengirim SMS sebagai satu batch ke manual-review/send-sms dan email satu per satu ke manual-review/send-email (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:193-233; useFurnishAPI.ts:118-203). Bila approval gagal, email/SMS tidak dikirim (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:202-208); bila kirim gagal, approval tetap dan pesan error ditampilkan (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:219-222). Edge case: sendEmailSms dicentang tanpa 'Add to send list' tidak mengirim apa pun dan hanya melaporkan approval (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:215,230-231). Jalur reject juga mengirim pesan, di luar story ini.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The email and SMS are sent to the recipient and each send is recorded
steps.detail: send-email memvalidasi txnNo, noticeNo, recipient, subject, htmlBody lalu memanggil sendAndRecordEmail (ManualReviewController.java:300-345; ManualReviewService.java:494-520), send-sms menerima single atau array dan memanggil sendAndRecordSms / batch (ManualReviewController.java:401-415; ManualReviewService.java:585-610). FurnishNotificationService mengirim lewat EmailService (SMTP) dan SmsUtil (APIM batch SMS) lalu menyimpan record service_type FURNISH dengan status S/E ke tabel email/SMS notification (FurnishNotificationService.java:50-84, 166-217). Tidak dimatikan config di repo: email.enableSmtp=true (application.properties:133; EmailService.java:40-43) dan sms.enable=true (application-prod.properties:36; SmsUtil.java:237-241); nilai server sebenarnya dan penerimaan nyata oleh SMTP/APIM cannot verify from repo.
